research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Zenflow is engaged in developing systems, devices, and methods for the delivery, deployment, and retrieval of implants into the prostatic urethra, as described in titles such as 'Systems, devices, and methods for the accurate deployment and imaging of an implant,' 'Methods for deployment of an implant,' and 'Systems, devices, and methods for the retrieval of an implant in the prostatic urethra.' These efforts focus on minimally invasive solutions for benign prostatic hyperplasia.

press_references.value: FDA Approves the Zenflow Spring® Implant and Delivery System for First-Line Interventional Therapy of Patients with Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia (BPH)

product_launches.description: Zenflow has received FDA approval for its Zenflow Spring Implant and Delivery System, effectively launching a first-line interventional therapy product for treating benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH).

overview_description.description: Zenflow was founded in 2014 by a team of Stanford University Biodesign Fellows working in collaboration with top global urologists. After witnessing patients' frustration with existing treatment options, the founders made it their mission to find a better solution to this large unmet clinical need.

identifier.value: Zenflow Spring® Implant and Delivery System

product.name: Zenflow Spring® Implant and Delivery System
product.description: A minimally invasive system for treating urinary symptoms caused by benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). It uses a temporary or implanted device and delivery system to support prostatic urethral patency without tissue removal.

product.name: Zenflow Single-Use Cystoscope
product.description: A single-use cystoscope designed for visualization during urologic procedures, including assessment and procedural guidance in patients with urinary tract conditions.
